name: Cassava Bread Sandwich
instructions: Layer lettuce, tomato, and avocado between slices of cassava bread.

name: Cassava Bread French Toast
instructions: Dip cassava bread in a mixture of eggs, milk, and cinnamon, then cook on a skillet until golden. Drizzle with honey.

name: Cassava Bread Avocado Toast
instructions: Mash avocado with lemon juice, spread over toasted cassava bread, and sprinkle with chili flakes.

name: Cassava Bread Pizza
instructions: Spread tomato sauce on cassava bread, add cheese and toppings, then bake until cheese melts.

name: Cassava Bread BLT
instructions: Layer bacon, lettuce, and tomato between cassava bread slices with a spread of mayonnaise.

name: Cassava Bread Grilled Cheese
instructions: Butter cassava bread, add cheese, and grill until cheese melts and bread is golden.

name: Cassava Bread Breakfast Wrap
instructions: Scramble eggs with vegetables, then wrap in cassava bread for a quick breakfast.

name: Cassava Bread with Peanut Butter
instructions: Spread peanut butter on cassava bread, add banana slices, and drizzle with honey.

name: Cassava Bread Bruschetta
instructions: Top toasted cassava bread with diced tomatoes, basil, garlic, and olive oil.

name: Cassava Bread Chicken Wrap
instructions: Fill cassava bread with grilled chicken, lettuce, avocado, and drizzle yogurt sauce on top.

name: Cassava Bread Caprese
instructions: Layer mozzarella and tomatoes on cassava bread, top with basil and balsamic glaze.

name: Cassava Bread Tuna Melt
instructions: Mix tuna with mayonnaise, place on cassava bread, add cheese, and toast until golden.

name: Cassava Bread Veggie Wrap
instructions: Spread hummus on cassava bread, add sliced vegetables, and roll tightly.

name: Cassava Bread with Smoked Salmon
instructions: Spread cream cheese on cassava bread, top with smoked salmon, capers, and dill.

name: Cassava Bread Dessert Toast
instructions: Spread Nutella on cassava bread, top with strawberries and a dollop of whipped cream.
